close_reason: SpacePatchOp + helper types landed in jmap-chat-types/src/space_set.rs. All 12 SpacePatchOp variants present (3 verbs × 4 collections: Role/Member/Channel/Category). RolePatch/MemberPatch/ChannelPatch/CategoryPatch use Clearable<T> for nullable fields (color, nick, categoryId, topic, slowModeSeconds, permissionOverrides) matching the existing chat-types Patch pattern. ChannelCreate added as the addChannels per-entry input (Chat is too broad for that). 11 new tests, all passing. Doc comments cite draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Space/set throughout. Scope deviation from bead description: OpResult type was NOT added here because SetError lives in jmap-server which jmap-chat-types cannot depend on (dependencies are jmap-types/serde/serde_json only). OpResult belongs in jmap-chat-server alongside the handler that produces it; file a sub-bead in .4.2 if needed.
description:
Foundation slice of JMAP-g7wu.2.4 (Space/set mutations). Must land first; .4.2 through .4.6 depend on these types existing.

Add to jmap-chat-types:

```rust
pub enum SpacePatchOp {
    AddRole(Role),
    RemoveRole(RoleId),
    UpdateRole(RoleId, RolePatch),
    AddMember(UserId, Vec<RoleId>),
    RemoveMember(UserId),
    UpdateMember(UserId, MemberPatch),
    AddChannel(Channel),
    RemoveChannel(ChannelId),
    UpdateChannel(ChannelId, ChannelPatch),
    AddCategory(Category),
    RemoveCategory(CategoryId),
    UpdateCategory(CategoryId, CategoryPatch),
}

pub struct RolePatch { /* per-field optional updates */ }
pub struct MemberPatch { /* per-field optional updates */ }
pub struct ChannelPatch { /* per-field optional updates */ }
pub struct CategoryPatch { /* per-field optional updates */ }

pub struct OpResult {
    pub op_index: usize,
    pub outcome: Result<Option<jmap_types::Id>, SetError>,
}
```

Reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Space/set lines 1072-1129. Wire keys map 1:1 to enum variants.

Acceptance:
- All 12 variants present
- RolePatch/MemberPatch/ChannelPatch/CategoryPatch use Clearable<T> for nullable fields (matching the existing chat-types Patch pattern)
- Round-trip JSON tests against RFC-style example fixtures
- Doc comments cite the draft section

Note: this is jmap-chat-types work, not jmap-chat-server. The server crate consumes these in .4.2 onwards.
